issues.summary: Trusted bearer configuration binds MCP principal and domain scope; forged caller scope is denied.
Hosted startup fails closed without bearer auth and local-dev bypass is loopback-only.
Policy returns one exhaustive deny, clarify, review, or execute decision.
Chat mutations use the canonical tool writer path, including local authority.
Undo uses explicit undone and undo_failed lifecycle semantics with canonical receipts.
Verifier false-green hole is closed.
Server JSON state uses shared locked atomic writes and corrupt-file quarantine.
Ingress enforces body limits, total deadlines, idle progress deadlines, and header bounds.
Chat idempotency and run state persist across restart with principal and conversation scoping.
Hidden plan hint no longer drives intent.
Chat send routes ignore client-supplied previous_response_id.
Retrieval has cache, timeout, circuit-breaker, source-budget, and freshness controls.
Notion pull paginates until target or limit.
A supervised startup worker recovers and drains the outbox with lease, retry, wake, and shutdown behavior.
Review-required proposals persist as awaiting_review.
Observer failures are durable, but delivery remains advisory.
Release readiness proof exists, but artifact terminology remains risky.
Ajv strict mode and expanded duplicate, invalid-op, and unknown-field mutants fail closed.
Real SQLite covers migrations, JSON, rollback, and foreign keys; broader writer-boundary coverage still uses MemoryDb.
Shared confidence contracts converge numeric provenance and qualitative policy semantics.
Completion consumes the registry and primary docs are refreshed; whole-V1 still needs current full-gate evidence.
Default repo gates avoid live mutation, but lane isolation is still soft.
